name: The Prince Sakura Tower Tokyo
accessSummary: Shinagawa Station (Shinkansen, JR lines and Keikyu Line) Takanawa Exit: about 3 min walk / Takanawadai Station (Toei Asakusa Line) Exit A1: about 5 min walk

rooms.name: Conference Floor 2F 1 Span
rooms.note: The official site describes it as "a multi-purpose space of 20 rooms gathered on one floor, where the size can be adjusted one room at a time." Boardroom: 18 seats.

rooms.name: Conference Floor 2F 2 Span
rooms.note: Boardroom: 20 seats. The U-shape and boardroom numbers are from the room specifications PDF (August 2024 edition); the other numbers are from the table on the hotel's venue page.

rooms.name: Conference Floor 2F 10 Span
rooms.note: The 10-span room is in the table on the hotel's venue page; the room specifications PDF (August 2024 edition) goes only up to 9 spans.

ops.loadingHours: The loading route is shown in the official load-in/load-out route map (page 54 of the brochure). At The Prince Sakura Tower Tokyo, the loading door is 1.9 m wide x 2.2 m high, the loading elevator door is 1.0 m wide x 2.1 m high, and the inside of the loading elevator car is 1.8 m wide x 2.0 m deep x 2.3 m high. (Banquet Hall Brochure, April 2024 edition)
ops.parking: The parking lot has 1,000 spaces and does not take reservations. The regular rate is 600 yen per 30 minutes (revised July 5, 2025). Parking is free for up to 4 hours for banquets and up to 2 hours for events (催し物); time beyond that is charged at the parking rate. The underground parking lot of International Convention Center Pamir is only for vehicles 2 m high or less. Vehicles 2 m or higher use the outdoor parking lot.
ops.catering: Meeting Package (April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027): the full day (8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.) is 16,000 yen per person, and the half day (4 hours within 8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.) is 12,000 yen per person, from 5 people. The room is a small banquet room or medium banquet room, and a room that fits the number of people is provided. Included are the room fee, screen/projector, refreshments (coffee, tea and small sweets) and mineral water. Lunch is a boxed meal (types on inquiry). A 60-minute extension is 1,600 yen per person. Bookings can be made from 3 months before the date of use.
ops.restaurants: Inside the hotel are CILIEGIO Ristorante Caffè, Japanese Restaurant NADAMAN TAKANAWA PRIME (private rooms available), Sushi Ginza Onodera NADAMAN TAKANAWA PRIME, and In-Room Dining. The restaurants and bars of Grand Prince Hotel Takanawa and Grand Prince Hotel Shin Takanawa, in the same Takanawa area, are also introduced on this page.
